lw_home.title: LifeWire: Together Against Domestic Violence
lw_home.description: LifeWire supports survivors of domestic violence on their journey toward safety, stability, and healing.

Planning to Leave Digital Safety Tips Why People Stay Talking with Survivors COMMUNITY ADVOCACY The Facts of DV DV by the Numbers Domestic Violence 101 Training SUPPORT US Donate New Items Gala Volunteering LifeWire News LifeWire Events LifeWire’s Community Circle Volunteer Careers ABOUT LIFEWIRE Our People Racial Equity Press Kit Contact Capital Campaign Stories from Survivors & Supporters DONATE Search If you or someone you know is concerned about or experiencing abuse, reach out to LifeWire at (425) 562-8840 to be connected with a trained advocate LifeWire is a leading provider of safety, stability, and healing for survivors of domestic violence in Washington State. Join us in changing mindsets and healing communities. Together, we are building a brighter future for survivors and their children. We support survivors Since 1982, we have partnered with over 176,000 domestic violence survivors. Theirs is a courageous journey towards safety, stability, and healing. Each day we work to ensure the security and independence of every survivor who calls for help. Our advocates are here to help survivors find resources to build safer lives. GET HELP Donate today Your financial support makes LifeWire’s work possible, providing thousands of survivors every year with the opportunity for brighter futures. Through a one-time donation, event sponsorship, in-kind contribution, or legacy gift, you can make a meaningful difference.

lw_gethelp.title: LifeWire - Get Help
lw_gethelp.description: If you or someone you know is concerned about your relationship or experiencing abuse, call our 24-Hour Helpline at 425-746-1940 to speak with an advocate.

Abuse doesn’t always look the same. It can be emotional, psychological, financial, physical, or sexual. Here are some of the most common warning signs. If you are experiencing abuse, remember: You are not alone. The abuse is not your fault. You deserve to be safe and have healthy relationships. If you or someone you know is concerned about or experiencing abuse, reach out to LifeWire at (425) 562-8840 to be connected with a trained advocate. How We Support Survivors Since 1982, LifeWire has helped over 169,000 survivors—including immigrants, men, teens, and members of the LGBTQIA2S+ community—find safety, stability, and healing.
